question:
I am trying to implement a solution of saving the logs from run_results.json into snowflake after any dbt command execution.

By using macros, I managed to save run_result.json file contents into a table (it is stored as variant data type), and in order to flatten the data/do more manipulations, I created a python model in dbt.

The problem is that I want this python model to be executed on-run-end, meaning after running any dbt operation (dbt run, dbt build, dbt test etc).

How can this be achieved?
title: DBT: Running python model on-run-end
answer:
As per documentation, only SQL statements are supported on-run-end.

on-run-start: sql-statement | [sql-statement]
on-run-end: sql-statement | [sql-statement]

As an alternative approach rather than creating a python model you could include the python logic in a snowflake procedure and then CALL the procedure as part of on-run-end.

Assuming your procedure name is python_script, you can use on-run-end hook at the end of dbt_project.yml

on-run-end:
  - 'CALL test.test.python_script(1, ''Alice'')'
